pre.js: (() => { const s = window.__sim, G = s.G; G.ohp = s.K.hp * 0.1; G.oNext = 1.7; document.getElementById('obar').style.width = '10%'; })()

anchor: (() => { const s = window.__sim, G = s.G; if (!G || G.phase !== 'fight' || G.t < 2.3) return false; const A = G.atk; return G.os === 'windup' && !!A && G.ot >= A.wind - 0.3; })()
